caseNameFull: Ng Fung Ho, otherwise known as Ung Kip v. Edward White, as Commissioner of Immigration for the Port of San Francisco

opinions.text: December 13, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit granted. Mr. Jackson H. Ralston and Mr. George W. Hott for petitioners. No brief filed for respondent.
